race.comment: BARRYS BROTHER (8) made a winning return at his latest appearance two weeks ago, getting home by 2 metres over 1609m at this track. Drawn to enjoy a cosy run but might need things to go his way at some stage. That latest effort is good enough to put him right in the finish. EBBONY STORM (1) was in the money at this track two runs ago before finishing tenth at her latest appearance over 1609m at this track, beaten 35 metres. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Tackles a similar assignment and she can finish a lot closer this time. LOCKITINEDDY (4) is on the radar after his last-start sixth over 1609m at this track a week ago. TERROR FLYING (3) showed pleasing improvement last time out when third over 1609m at this track.
